### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book suitable for non-native English speakers?**
Yes, the beautiful, simple rhythms and clear concepts make it an excellent tool for early language acquisition in any language setting.

**How does reading rhyming books help my child learn to read?**
Rhymes help develop phonological awareness. By hearing predictable sounds and patterns (like rhymes), children naturally begin to understand how words sound and structure, which is foundational to decoding written text.
